data.name: Awhad
data.gender_notes: Awhad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘awhada’, meaning 'to repeat' or 'to echo'. This name is mentioned in the Quran in reference to the Prophet's night journey (Isra and Mi'raj) and his encounter with different prophets and messengers. It symbolizes continuity, consistency, and repetition in the divine message. The name Awhad carries the meaning “Echo, Repeat” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Awhad usually hope their child will grow to embody echo, repeat and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Awhad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Echo, Repeat.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awhad total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_english.name: Awhad
in_english.meaning: Unique, one and only, singular, unmatched
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'w-h-d', which conveys the meaning of unity, oneness, and singularity. In Islamic tradition, Awhad is an attribute of Allah, signifying His uniqueness and oneness. The name is mentioned in the Quran (3:18), emphasizing the unity of God. Awhad symbolizes the divine attribute of being the only one, unmatched and unparalleled.
